known_limitations: The 0.08 meaningful-gain threshold is a substantive judgment that requires independent adversarial review and later cost/feasibility evidence; it is not empirically estimated.
Simulation assumptions are planning scenarios rather than estimates from confirmatory data; additional outcome-blind sensitivity scenarios may be added only before HOLDOUT.

The simulation assigns each base scenario to one balanced model profile instead of crossing every scenario with all profiles; H2 model-generalization inference is secondary and must report heterogeneity.
The powered recommendation is 600 HOLDOUT plus 600 REPLICATION scenarios, implying 2400 total under the old split; WP-007 may require scope narrowing before data.
The transient POWER_RESULTS.json was not committed because the WP-006 allowed-path packet did not list that path, although its hash and summary are recorded.
The repository validate_analysis_registry.py is currently an artifact-level wrapper; independent review should require semantic validation of registry, assumptions and results before GATE-001.
unexpected_findings: The earlier target of 600 total scenarios is not powered under the frozen primary design; 600 is required independently for HOLDOUT and REPLICATION.
The adverse heterogeneity/failure scenario did not require a larger count than design after calibrating both to the same scenario-level effect, but 540 remained below the 0.90 gate in both.
Powered mode coverage may dominate compute cost even with one model profile per scenario, making WP-007 a genuine gate rather than an administrative checklist.
